blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will welcome Polish President Karol Nawrocki to the Philippines for a state visit from Oct. 5 to 8, the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) announced Friday. The visit will be the first by a Polish head of state to the Philippines and is expected to further strengthen bilateral relations between the two countries. Marcos and Nawrocki will discuss cooperation in defense and security, trade and investment, agriculture, science and technology, information and communications technology, legal cooperation, tourism and people-to-people exchanges, according to the PCO.
